jobs.prompt: Fix: orchestratorModeEnabled in tools/shell-writes.mjs only enables orchestrator mode when the directory .swarm/orchestrator-mode exists, so it is OFF by default. The owner requires it ON by default for every project root (not a worker cwd, not a scratch/test root): enabled unless the owner-only off file .swarm/orchestrator-mode/off exists. Keep isWorkerCwd and scratch-root exemptions (a swarm worker workspace, tests' temp bases, and the .swarm worktrees must never be treated as orchestrator sessions: workers run node/test commands). Check the guard against a real call: with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set to a project root and cwd the root, `node -e 1`, `python3 -c 1`, `ls; node x.js`, `git log | head -300`, `cat a | sh` must be DENIED, while `git status -s | head -5`, `swarm tickets --status blocked`, `grep -n foo f | head -50`, `gh pr view 3` must be allowed. Add those exact cases as tests that drive tools/handbuild-guard.mjs as a subprocess with a temp project root (git init, a .swarm dir without any orchestrator-mode dir). Also add a test that a cwd inside .swarm/workspaces or a scratch tmp root is NOT blocked. Update docs where orchestrator mode is described to say default on, off file to disable. Run the new tests plus tests/orchestrator-mode.test.mjs and all the handbuild, self-approval and shell-writes test files in tests/ (ls tests | grep).
